subject: Urgent: error spike & retry storm — compensation and fallback plan
messages:
From: Maya Singh <m.singh@tangocorp.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@tangocorp.com
Date: Mon, 8 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Spike in 5xx/429s this morning — causing timeouts and upstream failures

Jonas / Redwood team,

We started seeing a significant spike in 5xx and 429 responses to our inference traffic beginning ~08:45 PT this morning. The elevated error rate lasted for ~40 minutes and coincided with a surge of retries from our side which amplified downstream timeouts. We observed: 
- 5xx rate peaked at ~4.7% across our primary route
- 429 rate peaked at ~2.1%
- End-to-end p95 latency increased from 320ms to ~1.6s
- Several customer-facing flows experienced timeouts and degraded UX

This affected our checkout and personalization pipelines. We attached logs and a CSV of observed retry timestamps. Our procurement team is copying in to start a compensation discussion — this is outside the typical acceptable window given our agreement. Please confirm receipt and expected next steps, including an initial timeline for RCA and a preliminary view on credits for impacted requests.

We need an urgent point of contact; cc'ing procurement for the billing side.

Thanks,
Maya Singh
Head of Platform Reliability | TangoCorp
Attachment: logs_snapshot_0608.zip (120KB), retry-patterns.csv (20KB)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Singh <m.singh@tangocorp.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 8 Jun 2026 09:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Spike in 5xx/429s this morning — causing timeouts and upstream failures

Maya — thanks for the heads up and the logs. We see your attachments and have already started a triage. Initial notes: 
- Our edge telemetry shows increased connection resets to the serving tier at ~08:43 PT.
- There's evidence of a retry amplification pattern from multiple client IP blocks (your CSV helps).

Immediate actions from Redwood:
1) We have throttled the affected route to a conservative concurrency cap to limit downstream queuing (completed at 09:25).
2) Engineering is collecting detailed traces and will run a persisted KV cache integrity check.
3) I'll schedule an incident bridge in 15 minutes and loop in SRE + product.

For credits: we will need to complete a short RCA to quantify the impacted token counts (so we can map to the SLA). I will share a preliminary credit range by EOD today. For now, our exec sponsor for TangoCorp will be Lauren (cc).

Point-of-contact on our side: Jonas Weber (jonas_weber@redwood.ai). Incident bridge info will follow.

— Jonas
Director, Customer Reliability | Redwood Inference
From: Incident Bridge <incident@redwood.ai>
To: m.singh@tangocorp.com, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 8 Jun 2026 09:35:00 -07:00
Subject: [Bridge] TangoCorp — Elevated error rates (5xx/429)

Join info: Zoom: https://zoom.example.com/j/123456789 (passcode: tango)

Notes from bridge start: 
- Owner: Redwood SRE (Marissa Cole)
- Symptom: transient 5xx/429 spike with retry amplification observed by TangoCorp
- Scope: TangoCorp primary route (prod-us-west)

Actions agreed on bridge:
- Redwood to provide hourly updates until resolved
- Collect request-level traces and token counts for impacted window
- TangoCorp to provide any client-side backoff logs (we have your CSV)

We will provide a preliminary impact estimate in the 11:00 status update.

-- Incident tooling: SUP-11234
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: m.singh@tangocorp.com, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 8 Jun 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: [Bridge] TangoCorp — Elevated error rates (5xx/429)

Maya — thanks for joining the bridge. Preliminary impact numbers based on our telemetry:
- Window: 08:43–09:21 PT
- Total requests from TangoCorp in window: 1,240,000
- Requests with 5xx/429: 86,400 (~6.97%)
- Rough token estimate impacted: ~2.1M generation tokens

Root cause (short): a transient resource scheduling misestimate on the serving tier combined with an aggressive client retry pattern. The scheduling misestimate temporarily reduced effective concurrency for TangoCorp's shard, which increased queueing; client retries then produced amplified load and additional 5xx/429s.

Next steps we will complete in the RCA (ETA 48 hours):
- Full timeline and traces (including kernel-level metrics)
- Exact token count for billable requests that failed or were retried
- Proposed credit calculation mapping to the SLA (we will use the standard formula in section 4.2)

Preliminary remediation we will apply immediately: temporary route isolation, a conservative retry-protection throttle at the edge for all high-volume customers, and a follow-up optimization to our scheduler to avoid shard under-provisioning for similar traffic patterns.

We will send an initial credit range by EOD today.

— Marissa
Sr SRE, Redwood Inference
From: procurement@tangocorp.com
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: m.singh@tangocorp.com, ravi.patel@tangocorp.com
Date: Tue, 9 Jun 2026 08:14:00 -07:00
Subject: TangoCorp request: formal credit estimate and timeline

Hi Lauren / Jonas,

Per TangoCorp procurement: we need a formal credit estimate for the outage window and a confirmation of how the credit will be applied to our upcoming invoice (June invoice). Please include:
- Exact token/request count that will be credited
- Dollar-value of the credit and calculation details (unit pricing applied)
- Timeline for credit posting to our account
- Any required acceptance or signature (PO or DocuSign) to apply the credit

We also want clarity on whether Redwood will accept a one-off expedited credit given the customer impact (we are assessing whether to escalate further). Please respond by EOD Tuesday.

Thanks,
TangoCorp Procurement
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: procurement@tangocorp.com, m.singh@tangocorp.com
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: TangoCorp request: formal credit estimate and timeline

Hi — following up with what we can commit based on the RCA draft and billing reconciliation. Apologies again for the customer impact. Summary and proposed outcome: 

Impact recap:
- Affected window: 08:43–09:21 PT on 2026-06-08
- TangoCorp requests impacted: 86,400
- Token estimate impacted: 2,100,000 generation tokens

Proposed credit (two components):
1) SLA credit: We will apply a credit equal to 100% of the billable token cost for the failed/errored requests within the window. Using TangoCorp's unit pricing (agreed in the deal), this equals $6,720.
2) Goodwill expedited credit: Redwood will apply an additional one-time operational credit of $4,000 to cover extra support and remediation costs, and to expedite reconciliation.

Total proposed credit: $10,720.

Timeline and mechanics:
- We will apply the credit to your June invoice; credit will be visible on the July 1 billing statement.
- No PO required. We will send a short acceptance email that you can reply to; DocuSign not required for this one-off credit.

Reliability commitments:
- We have implemented an edge-level retry protection and an immediate scheduler fix to avoid shard under-provisioning.
- We are scheduling a joint postmortem next week to review mitigations and any SDK/backoff guidance TangoCorp wants to adopt.

If this is acceptable, please confirm and we will finalize posting. If you want a slightly higher expedited credit (e.g., to accelerate settlement before the June close), flag that and we will escalate to the revenue team.

— Lauren Bishop
VP, Enterprise Accounts | Redwood Inference
